segments.name: Foundation works
segments.description: Provides substructure and foundation works plus related construction services in Hong Kong, mostly for public sector clients as a subcontractor.
segments.evidence: The single segment represents the Company's core business of providing foundation works and other foundation related ancillary works to its customers in Hong Kong.

revenueModel.text: Hong Kong public and private sector customers pay the company for substructure works, mostly as a subcontractor, and for advisory and supervision services charged monthly.
